task: Rudder packaged account-gate memory-only storage implementation

findings.detail: The implementation treats three changed Electron client files as retained desktop client code, but the inventory validator requires a reviewed_node_changes record for each changed runtime source and currently only allows compatibility_adapter/transport_adapter roles with nonempty rust_authority. These files are neither Node backend adapters nor Rust-owned implementations. Calling them transport_adapter or claiming Rust owns the Electron credential vault/startup policy would be inaccurate. Add a narrowly scoped retained_client role (and a matching modified_retained_client change kind) for desktop client sources, with validator tests and field semantics that distinguish associated backend authority from client-side credential storage.

No functional blocker found in the reviewed diff. The legacy account-bypass predicate is preserved; the new storage-memory predicate requires packaged mode, Rudder-smoke name, valid marker, Darwin, memory mode, and explicit opt-in; default packaged storage and packaged Darwin process-memory fallback remain native/disabled. The memory account-gate path explicitly disables both auth-bypass flags, uses production Identity for provider handoff, checks account_required/no local server, skips Electron safeStorage probes/decrypt, and labels vault persistence NOT EXECUTED. Native mode remains the default and keeps its encryption/restart-decrypt assertions.
